newsitem.title: USA: Affinity drops after market marker's fall.
newsitem.headline: Affinity drops after market marker's fall.

text.p: Affinity Entertainment Inc's share price has been hurt by the company's market maker going out of business earlier this week, a company spokeswoman said on Thursday.
"There's nothing wrong with the company's fundamentals," Affinity spokeswoman Sue McCammon said.
The company produces television programs and feature films for all media worldwide
Affinity shares were halted for trading at 3-7/16 on 1,035,100 shares traded today. The company's shares had touched a low of 2-1/2 during trading.
